buildings.name: Courthouse Square
buildings.tagline: A calm, professional home for your business.
buildings.description: Courthouse Square is a quiet, well-kept office building on Vashon Hwy SW with free parking, a shared patio, and an easy in-and-out for you and your visitors. There's room here for all sorts of small businesses to settle in and grow, from therapists and bodyworkers to attorneys, accountants, and designers. If you'd like a calm, professional space, I'd love to show you around.
featureBullets: Free on-site parking, with plenty to go around
A shared outdoor patio, open to all tenants
Walking distance to the Athletic Center, the schools, and a Metro bus stop
A quiet, low-traffic setting where clients can think and talk
